title: Signal + Habit Commitments (personal metrics scratchpad)
content:
Purpose: quick-running personal dashboard and commitment log for the next 8 weeks. Focus on building small daily signals that compound toward 2 outcome goals: (A) shipping a lightweight tutorial flow for the hosted API sample app and (B) lowering my personal interrupt overhead so I can carve focused deep work windows.

Top-level outcome hypotheses:
- Outcome A (tutorial flow shipped): shipping a 1-hour guided tutorial unlocks 3x higher trial->active conversion on sample app signups (hypothesis). Leading signals: number of tutorial runs, average completion time, post-tutorial API calls.
- Outcome B (interrupt reduction): reducing meeting overruns and async pings will increase 2-hour uninterrupted blocks/week from current 3 -> 9 and increase measurable deep work velocity (PRs merged / focused block). Leading signals: uninterrupted-blocks/week, daily context switches, # of Slack threads started after 3PM.

Signal list (candidate, prioritized):
1) Daily 90-min focus block (2x per workday) — signal: started+finished marker in calendar and Quick Note.
2) Tutorial draft checkpoint — signal: commit with README update + one recorded run.
3) 10-minute end-of-day triage log — signal: 5 bullet summary logged before 18:00.
4) No-meet-after-3 rule on Tue/Thu — signal: calendar compliance flag.
5) Microplaybacks: 1-minute screencast after feature demo — signal: uploaded clip link.

Minimum commitments for next 2 weeks (concrete):
- Every weekday: mark 1 focus block completed and add a 5-line quick note (2 weeks = 10 notes).
- Ship tutorial v0: reach feature parity for core flow and collect 3 internal runs.
- Run calendar audit: remove/reduce 2 recurring meetings and set 2 no-meet days.

Weekly check-in template (use as copy each Fri):
- Week range: 
- Focus blocks achieved / planned: 
- Tutorial progress: commits / runs / blockers: 
- Interrupt metric: context switches / no-meet compliance: 
- Wins: small wins here 
- Blockers / decisions needed: list 
- Next week commitments (3 items): 

Quick retro notes (ongoing):
- 2024-09-25: Started experiment; found that starting blocks right after standup increases consistency. Need to move standup to 10:15 on M/W.
- 2024-10-02: Tutorial flow is stalling on onboarding text; helper snippets cut friction — add snippet library.
- 2024-11-12: Calendar audit completed; removed 2 recurring syncs and saved ~90min/week. Starting to see 1 extra uninterrupted block on Thu.

Experiment log (short):
- Exp: focus-block alarm tones vs silent start (A/B for retention of block).
  - Hypothesis: light alarm increases start rate by 20% but may increase context cost.
  - Status: A/B running until end of week. Early signal: +10% start rate.
- Exp: tutorial run incentives (internal badge) vs documentation-only.
  - Hypothesis: badge yields more runs but lower quality feedback.
  - Status: paused; rework questions first.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Do I track tutorial completion as binary or by engagement score? (need to define engagement score: steps completed / time / replay viewed)
- Can I delegate initial tutorial runs to Solutions Eng for higher-quality feedback? Ask Samir.
- Which metrics to add to personal dashboard? Keep it minimal: runs, focus blocks, uninterrupted hours.

Links and references:
- Personal productivity book notes: "Atomic Habits" page highlights (quick list)
- Confluence: personal-playbook (see linked_artifacts)
- PRs: link to WIP tutorial branch in GH (scratchpad)

Style notes (for when converting to a more formal personal playbook):
- Keep outcomes framed as measurable experiments, not just intentions.
- Capture leading indicators that are easy to log (manual is OK for early weeks).
- Keep weekly check-ins <10 minutes to avoid becoming another task.

End: small signature: lena — quick wins > grand plans.

(Handy copyable checklist)
- [ ] 10 end-of-day quick notes (2 weeks)
- [ ] tutorial v0 recorded run x3
- [ ] set no-meet days Tue/Thu
- [ ] calendar audit notes added to Confluence
